what_happened: Review finding (A)'s premise ('latex/build/ and latex/subfiles/ untracked and matched by no .gitignore pattern') is refuted by git check-ignore: every file under latex/ is already ignored by the existing generic, unanchored 'build/' rule on .gitignore line 3 (incidental match, not the rule's intended target) or by latex/**/*.log. Zero files are tracked under latex/. Recommended proceeding with the explicit latex/build/ rule anyway for clarity/robustness, but flagged the corrected impact in the report.

Traced Challenge.lean's git history (2 commits, both from now-archived tasks 849/850) and found their challenge/manifest.json records plus .claude/scripts/lean-challenge-snapshot.sh's design doc. This established that Challenge.lean is the deliberate, mechanically-produced Comparator trust-boundary artifact, not a stray scratch file -- so the dispatch's 'relocate to Boneyard' option would have been actively wrong (breaks the mechanism's root-path precondition). Correct fix is documenting it in ORGANISATION.md only.

Research report's recommended ORGANISATION.md row text cites agent-system/extensions/lean/.../challenge-snapshot.md, a path that does not exist in this repository at all (no agent-system/ tree), and its deployed counterpart lives under the gitignored .claude/ tree (.gitignore:106 /.claude). Writing either into tracked ORGANISATION.md would be a dead reference in a fresh clone. Plan Phase 2 corrects this by naming the script by basename in prose with no path citation.

validate-artifact.sh's advisory sentinel-claim scan caught a false __FULL_SWEEP__ Tier Justification claim that arose purely from naming the token in explanatory prose (the line asserted the opposite). Caught and fixed at authoring time rather than surfacing as a dishonest claim downstream; plan now validates with 0 warnings.

verify-touched.sh .gitignore reports a NEW failure in .claude/scripts/tests/test-verify-deploy-gate-selection.sh case(t) (--only-gate 1 --corpus-probe expects a [verify-deploy] corpus: line). Root-caused: unrelated to the .gitignore edit -- the test's FIXTURE_RICH setup rsyncs REPO_ROOT/agent-system/extensions/, a directory that does not exist anywhere in this repository (confirmed via ls), so the corpus-probe guard's -d agent-system/extensions check can never pass regardless of .gitignore content. Reproduces identically when run standalone with no task changes applied. Pre-existing, out of scope for task 943.

verify-touched.sh .gitignore ORGANISATION.md: ORGANISATION.md did not resolve to a specific covering suite, so verify-touched.sh ran its OWED fallback (free cost-class, 95 suites) for that path, surfacing 11 NEW (not previously expected) suite failures: test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh, test-gate-out-derived-staleness.sh, test-gate-out-self-attribution.sh, test-generate-task-order.sh, test-lint-hook-registration-paths.sh, test-manifest-scripts-sync.sh, test-orchestrate-conclusion-aggregate.sh, test-reconcile-demote-stranded.sh, test-reconcile-handoff-status.sh, test-resume-scan-nonconformance.sh, test-sweep-invalidated-claims.sh. Root cause confirmed pre-existing and unrelated to this task's edit: several failures explicitly cite agent-system/extensions/... paths not found, and this entire repository has no agent-system/ directory (confirmed via ls) -- a structural fact independent of any file content. The two suites that WOULD catch a problem in the added ORGANISATION.md row (test-check-record-versioning.sh, test-check-task-references.sh) both PASS. Not treated as a regression; out of scope for task 943 to fix.
